search_seo.interpretation: Synthetic fixture: the search axis of the reference run.

ai_visibility.interpretation: Synthetic fixture: the AI axis of the reference run.

findings.title: Page has no <title>

evidence.observed: No <title> element in the head of https://example.com/a.

findings.expected: Every indexable page declares one non-empty <title>.
findings.recommendation: Add a descriptive <title> to this template.

verification.assertion: The document has exactly one non-empty <title>.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents the title as the primary source of the search result link.

findings.title: Meta description below the pass band

evidence.observed: The meta description of https://example.com/b is 41 characters.

findings.recommendation: Extend the description so it summarises the page.

verification.assertion: The meta description length is inside the pass band.

expected_impact.rationale: A short description is more often rewritten by the engine.

findings.title: No rel=canonical on an indexable page

evidence.observed: No <link rel="canonical"> and no Link header on https://example.com/c.

findings.expected: Every indexable URL declares the canonical version of itself.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referential canonical to this template.

verification.assertion: The head carries exactly one self-referential rel=canonical.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents rel=canonical as its strongest canonicalisation signal.

findings.title: og:image present
findings.expected: A reachable og:image of at least 200x200.
findings.recommendation: Keep the social card image reachable.

expected_impact.rationale: Social cards affect click-through on shared links.

findings.title: Internal link returns 404

evidence.observed: 1 of 12 internal links on https://example.com/e answered 404.

findings.recommendation: Repoint or remove the broken link.

expected_impact.rationale: Broken internal links waste crawl budget and lose link equity.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals field data unavailable

evidence.observed: No PSI_API_KEY in the environment, so no CrUX field data was requested.

findings.expected: Field data for the origin from the CrUX dataset.
findings.recommendation: Set PSI_API_KEY and re-run to measure this.

verification.assertion: The PSI response carries loadingExperience for the URL.

expected_impact.rationale: Core Web Vitals are a documented ranking signal; unmeasured is not the same as passing.

findings.title: Indexable URLs missing from the sitemap

evidence.observed: 4 indexable URLs found by the crawl are absent from every sitemap.

findings.expected: Every indexable URL appears in a sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing URLs to the sitemap.

verification.assertion: Each indexable crawl URL appears in a sitemap <loc>.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents sitemaps as a discovery aid for URLs that internal linking reaches poorly.

findings.title: Content images without alt text

evidence.observed: 6 of 9 content images on https://example.com/only-in-a have no alt attribute.

findings.expected: Content images carry descriptive alt text.
findings.recommendation: Add alt text to the content images of this template.

verification.assertion: Every content has an alt attribute.

expected_impact.rationale: Alt text is the documented textual description of an image for search and assistive technology.
